name: split_request_ticket_only
title: The approval ticket on a request of its own; the SAP change log was asked for on another request

control.title: New and changed SAP S/4HANA access is approved before it is granted
control.activity: New and changed user access to SAP S/4HANA production (PRD, client 100) is requested through a ServiceNow catalog item that names the user and each role. The user's line manager and the owner of each role approve the request in ServiceNow before SAP Security assigns the role. SAP Security, who neither request nor approve the access, assign only the roles approved.

attributes.text: The access was requested through a ServiceNow ticket that names the user and the SAP S/4HANA role.

criteria.condition: A ServiceNow request exists for the user's new or changed SAP S/4HANA access.
criteria.pass_when: The ticket identifies the requester, the user who receives the access and the exact SAP role requested.
criteria.exception_when: No ticket exists, or the ticket does not name the user or the role.

attributes.text: The access was approved by the user's line manager and the role owner before it was granted.

criteria.condition: Approval of the request by the user's line manager and by the role owner is recorded.
criteria.pass_when: Both approvals are timestamped before the SAP change document shows the role assigned.
criteria.exception_when: An approval is missing, is given by someone other than the named approver, or is dated after the role was assigned.

attributes.text: The requester, the approvers and the person who granted the access are different people.

criteria.condition: The requester, each approver and the SAP user who assigned the role are different people.
criteria.pass_when: Neither approver is the requester or the user who receives the access, and the role was assigned by a member of SAP Security who did not approve the request.
criteria.exception_when: A person approves their own request, or an approver also assigns the role.

attributes.text: The access granted in SAP S/4HANA is the access approved, and was granted within the audit period.

criteria.condition: The SAP S/4HANA change document shows the role approved in the ticket assigned to the same user.
criteria.pass_when: The assignment is dated within the audit period, 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026.
criteria.exception_when: A different role or user is changed, or the assignment falls outside the audit period.
